goal: Define the smallest semantic extension needed to implement and test one encrypted, durable, no-price Solana co-ownership vertical on Devnet, including recipient-requested key reissue.
goal_limits: preserve accepted KEP-SOL-D1 through KEP-SOL-D10 bytes and meaning
reuse accepted generic Durable Storage meaning instead of redefining it
define cryptographic profile shape without selecting algorithms or libraries
define three-layer storage obligations without selecting a provider or SQL dialect
separate reissue request from authorized fulfillment
separate storage preparation from finalized chain activation
treat Devnet as real external test execution but not Mainnet or production
no definition acceptance, Product Capability adoption, ontology, DomainSpec, implementation, credentials, transaction, publication, release, or deployment effect
original_intent: Extend the definitions now so the protocol has the right substrate before its Product Capability, ontology, DomainSpec, Solana program, storage integration, and real-Devnet evidence are evolved.

context.name: Knowledge Exchange Protocol first complete Solana trial substrate
context.statement: A grants B co-ownership without knowledge consideration; encrypted material is prepared under the accepted Durable Storage contract; B can request reissue; external delivery activates only after the exact Solana transition reaches the configured commitment; one bounded Devnet evidence bundle records the result.
context.provenance: Current-chat owner direction plus accepted KEP, Solana realization, and Durable Storage definition sources.

context_sufficiency.derivation: The accepted Solana set defines the grant, atomicity, replay, no-price boundary, evidence, and program identity. The accepted Durable Storage set defines generic storage, reissue-safe replacement, confidentiality, evidence, cost, and consumer instantiation. The residue is the exact consumer bridge, cryptographic profile shape, reissue request/fulfillment, activation boundary, and Devnet evidence semantics.
residue: No concrete cryptographic algorithm or library is selected.
No retention, recovery, availability, replication, or deletion value is accepted beyond the required three-layer posture shape.
No SQL adapter, provider, endpoint, credential, wallet, RPC service, program ID, or upgrade authority is selected.
No successor Product Capability, ontology, DomainSpec source, implementation binding, or Devnet deployment exists.
The exact activation commitment and propagation-policy reissue fulfiller remain successor Product Capability decisions.

consumer.intended_use: Reviewable meaning input for one successor no-price Solana Product Capability and its later D65 construction chain.

concepts.candidate_definition_summary: Complete versioned encryption, envelope, encoding, domain-separation, nonce, associated-data, and compatibility contract without algorithm selection or security proof.
Consumer-owned storage semantics for encrypted artifacts and envelopes, readiness, failure, three layers, policy, confidentiality, and cost without provider selection.
B-authorized, replay-safe request for same-owner replacement access material that has no fulfillment effect.
Policy-authorized atomic update of only B's active envelope commitment after verified replacement storage.
Prepared stored material becomes active only after configured chain commitment and exact stored/on-chain commitment equality.
Real public Devnet experiment using test identities and test SOL with explicit non-production boundaries.
One immutable trial receipt connecting the exact D65 chain, cryptography, storage, chain state, decryption, reissue, negative tests, and costs.

open_questions.question: Which exact cryptographic algorithms, parameters, serialization, and audited library realization will the successor bind?
open_questions.owner: Knowledge Exchange Protocol security and product owners
open_questions.required_before: Product Capability successor adoption or implementation binding, whichever first fixes these values

open_questions.question: Which exact retention, recovery, availability-observation, archive, migration, and deletion values complete the three-layer policy?
Which Propagation Policy role fulfills B's reissue request in the first trial?
Will the first Devnet trial bind activation to Solana finalized commitment as recommended?

challenge_or_refresh_route: Return challenged terms, sources, boundaries, or open values to CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE; acceptance requires CA2-ROUTE-GOVERNANCE and one immutable extension-source digest.
claim_ceiling: Candidate completion definitions and Definition Pack only; no successor acceptance, Product Capability adoption, Durable Storage instantiation authority, ontology, DomainSpec, implementation, cryptographic selection, transaction, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
